method: Ten actual UI restart clicks on frozen scene, each awaited ready; public Phaser resource counters only, no forced GC or retained heap claim

resources.method: Phaser public texture/scene/sound registries and CanvasPool; current document canvas elements; sampled on getState
resources.limitations: Counts, not bytes, GPU allocation, decoded audio memory, or GC/leak proof. Texture keys exclude Phaser built-ins; texture canvases are unique registered HTMLCanvasElements, not all detached/offscreen canvases. DOM/CanvasPool counts cover the page, and the pool covers 2D canvases only; free entries remain pooled. Display lists include inactive scenes but count top-level entries, not nested Container children or arbitrary retained objects. Sound counts include pending removal until the manager next updates.
